public_rationale: The sources establish neither the asserted minimum loss duration nor a comparable profitable counterexample. A cost model is not a realized profit history, and CoreWeave's consolidated accounts do not identify each facility's economics. The claim also leaves its accounting basis unspecified. The multibillion-cost component cannot justify supporting the whole statement, and capital recovery cannot be substituted for annual profit.
limitations: The unknown accounting basis independently prevents a supported or contradicted verdict.
The cost model concerns a hypothetical one-gigawatt facility, not all AI data centers.
The quoted financial disclosure covers one quarter, not a facility's complete service history.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI data centers cost billions upfront and, at best, run at a loss for their first five or six years, if they ever recover their costs.

statement.excerpt: AI data centers are ruinously expensive, requiring billions in upfront funding with operating costs so high that they, at best, run at a loss for the first five or six years of service, if they ever recover their original costs at all.

from_speaker: at best, run at a loss for the first five or six years of service
if they ever recover their original costs at all
our_interpretation: This is a general claim about facility economics, not a claim about one named operator's consolidated accounts.
The plain reading of run at a loss is negative periodic profit after relevant costs. It is distinct from taking several years to recover the initial investment.
At best is an asserted lower bound, not a conditional antecedent. A comparable facility achieving sustained profit before five years would challenge it.

I use the first quarter of 2026, the latest completed financial quarter before the post, as the reporting reference for the ongoing claim. Testing the duration also requires each facility's earlier operating history.
No accounting basis is identified. I do not silently substitute GAAP net income, adjusted EBITDA or a modeled capital-recovery period.
Ruinously expensive is evaluative; the checkable components are upfront funding and the asserted minimum loss duration.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable facility accounts establish multibillion upfront funding and losses throughout at least the first five years, with representative coverage sufficient to support the general claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable accounts for a comparable AI data center establish sustained profit before its fifth service anniversary, on the same identified accounting basis; representative cost records could also contradict the asserted general upfront funding requirement.
